verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance platform. Duplicate-identity detection is a fair question for that category, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only sanctions/PEP/adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, and transaction monitoring, with no documented face or document matching or automatic flagging of identities resurfacing under different names. The external-identifier customer lookup is an adjacent record-retrieval feature, not duplicate detection.
